rows.headline: ECB hikes interest rates for first time since 2023 as Iran war ramps up energy costs

rows.headline: Bank of Japan rate hike a 'done deal' given inflation and weak yen
rows.prelim_note: BoJ set to raise policy rate from 0.75% to 1.0% at June 15-16 meeting — first time since 1995 — as inflation persists; unwinds global carry trade and reshapes Japanese equities and yen-sensitive sectors (materiality: shifts supply/demand and analyst expectations across rate-sensitive and export-sensitive names)

rows.headline: U.S. crude oil falls below $85 as U.S. and Iran near a deal to reopen Hormuz
rows.prelim_note: WTI crude fell 3.2% to $84.88 — 8-week low and ~6% weekly drop — on 80% probability a US-Iran Hormuz deal will be signed within days; directly changes margins for energy producers and input costs for transportation (materiality: commodity price move changes revenue and margins)

rows.headline: Adobe Q2 2026 earnings: CFO Dan Durn exits, stock falls
rows.prelim_note: Adobe reported record Q2 revenue $6.62B (+13% YoY) and raised FY26 guidance, but CFO Dan Durn departs June 15 to Marvell while CEO Narayen exit is also already announced — dual leadership gap compounds uncertainty despite strong AI-driven results (materiality: affects management credibility and shifts analyst expectations)
